metadata.timing: Median of three alternating runs. Only step() is timed; construction, assertions, support oracle, fixture scans and sleep calls excluded. First wake is separate from subsequent active calls. Sparse calls predict fewer than one quarter of all grains. Dense control is measured, not assumed regression-free.
metadata.comparison: Identical initial cells and deterministic state. Consumer-visible conservation, geometry, stable rest, majority cavity closure and remote fall are asserted; RNG trajectories need not match.
